children.name: Pterostemon mexicanus Schauer

children.name: Pterostemon rotundifolius Ramírez

children.name: Itea
children.description: Itea — a genus of magnoliopsidas.

children.name: Itea amoena Chun
children.description: The native range of this species is China (SW. Guangxi). It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Itea chinensis Hook. & Arn.
children.description: The native range of this species is Himalaya to S. China and Indo-China. It is a tree and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.
children.distribution: Himalaya to S. China and Indo-China

children.name: Itea coriacea Y.C.Wu
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. China (to Guizhou), Hainan. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Itea glutinosa Hand.-Mazz.
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. China (to Guizhou). It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Itea ilicifolia Oliv.
children.description: Itea ilicifolia, the holly-leaved sweet spire, is a species of flowering plant in the family Iteaceae, native to western China.

children.name: Itea indochinensis Merr.
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Guizhou, Guangxi, S. Yunnan) to Vietnam. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.
children.distribution: China (Guizhou, Guangxi, S. Yunnan) to Vietnam

children.name: Itea japonica Oliv.
children.description: The native range of this species is SC. & S. Japan. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Itea kiukiangensis C.C.Huang & S.C.Huang
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. Tibet to China (NW. Yunnan). It is a tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Itea kwangsiensis H.T.Chang
children.description: The native range of this species is China (N. Guangxi). It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Itea macrophylla Wall. ex Roxb.
children.description: The native range of this species is Himalaya to China (S. Yunnan, Guangxi) and W. & C. Malesia. It is a tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Itea maesifolia Elmer
children.description: The native range of this species is Philippines (Luzon, Leyte). It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Itea nutans Royle
children.description: The native range of this species is NE. Pakistan to W. Himalaya and N. India. It is a tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Itea oldhamii C.K.Schneid.
children.description: The native range of this species is Nansei-shotō to N. Taiwan. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Itea omeiensis C.K.Schneid.
children.description: The native range of this species is S. China. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Itea parviflora Hemsl.
children.description: The native range of this species is Taiwan. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Itea rhamnoides  Kubitzki
children.description: The native range of this species is SW. Uganda to S. Africa. It is a scrambling shrub or tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Itea riparia Collett & Hemsl.
children.description: The native range of this species is China (S. Yunnan, W. Guangxi) to Indo-China. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Itea tenuinervia S.Y.Liu
children.description: Itea tenuinervia S.Y.Liu — a magnoliopsida species in the genus Itea.
